title: Delivery fragment, contract version 1
description: What a fragment of the delivery API holds of an answer (PRD 8.12, 9.3): its HTTP status, the form and the bytes of its body, and whether a shared cache may serve it stale. The fragment store keeps it under the fragment's key with the fragment's content keys and valid_until; it is the delivery API's own and never leaves the server. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Delivery\Domain\Dto\StoredAnswer, and the generated codec DeliveryFragmentCodecV1 writes and reads its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace. A fragment the codec does not read is rebuilt, never served.

body.description: The bytes of the answer's body, a document of delivery.v1.json, problem.v1.json or delivery-explanation.v1.json as format says.

format.description: The form of the body: record, problem or explanation.

stale.description: Whether a shared cache may serve the answer stale while it refetches it or while the origin fails.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.
